about: The only place where effect colours have hex values. Effect files name roles only. 'from' says whose value it is: mustafa = his decision; art-lead = the Art lead's working value (instruction of 2026-11-14); board-v7 = the Art lead's proposal on the VFX drawing board v7; derived = computed by Shamble VFX from those values with the board's own formula; assumed = Shamble VFX's guess, waiting for a decision.

team.dark.note: team x 0.7: the pushed-back copy of a comic word (board v7)

glow.hot.note: glow mixed with 25 % white: the hot core of a beam (board v7)

gunsmoke.note: gun smoke #CFC8BC in sunlight (board v7 draws it lit)

dust.note: stone #D0C2A2 mixed with 25 % white, in sunlight (board v7's hit dust)

gunword.back.note: the pushed-back copy of a small gun's word, every team (study 5.0)

scorch.splat.note: a burnt splat under a fire, multiplied (board v7: white mixed 90 % with #74604F)

smoke.dark.note: darker blast smoke #8E8880 in sunlight (board v7)

heat.rim.note: heat.1 x 0.62: the thin broken rim of your own team's blast (board v7)
